title: Devbox support
summary: Research-first devbox observability workstream: prove access, remote session-state observation, identity, security, and health contracts before implementation consumes the in-flight local session/runtime checkpoints.

nodes.title: Devbox scope and dependency map
nodes.summary: Define the exact devbox observability boundary and map which external checkpoints from session-launching-and-tracking must be consumed before implementation starts.

nodes.title: Devbox access spike
nodes.summary: Identify the concrete host registration and access model Streamliner can rely on for the first devbox observability slice.

nodes.title: Remote Copilot state spike
nodes.summary: Confirm where Copilot CLI session state lives on the devbox, what metadata and events are available, and how compatible that shape is with local observation.

nodes.title: Remote observation transport spike
nodes.summary: Evaluate the viable scan/watch transport for reading devbox session state from the local Streamliner process, including latency, consistency, and failure modes.

nodes.title: Environment identity spike
nodes.summary: Define host, environment, path, repo, branch, and Copilot-session identity rules so devbox sessions can merge into the registry without colliding with local sessions.

nodes.title: Devbox health and freshness spike
nodes.summary: Define the health, freshness, degraded-confidence, and unreachable-host states that make devbox observation trustworthy enough to operate from.

nodes.title: Devbox security and credential spike
nodes.summary: Determine how devbox registration records, credentials, secrets, and trust boundaries should work without committing sensitive data or widening Streamliner's local-first scope.

nodes.title: Devbox research contract gate
nodes.summary: Operator reviews the spike findings and accepts the devbox access, observation, identity, health, and security contracts before implementation nodes are promoted.

nodes.title: External runtime checkpoint gate
nodes.summary: Wait for session-launching-and-tracking to export the specific registry storage/identity, registry sync, local observation, and session-surface contracts that devbox implementation consumes; launch-from-graph is not a blanket prerequisite for devbox observability.

nodes.title: Devbox host registration
nodes.summary: Implement the accepted devbox host registration model without storing secrets in committed artifacts or creating a general host-fleet manager.

nodes.title: Devbox session discovery
nodes.summary: Discover Copilot CLI sessions from registered devbox hosts and produce observation records that align with the local session watcher contract.

nodes.title: Devbox registry merge
nodes.summary: Merge discovered devbox sessions into the primary session registry with environment-aware identity, preserving builder-owned fields and avoiding local/devbox collisions.

nodes.title: Devbox operational surface
nodes.summary: Surface devbox sessions, freshness, degraded confidence, and unreachable-host states through the existing session/registry UI without taking ownership of the portfolio shell.

nodes.title: Devbox observability usable
nodes.summary: A real devbox's Copilot sessions are visible in Streamliner with trustworthy identity, freshness, and failure states, and local session behavior still follows the primary registry contract.

checkpoints.title: Research foundation
checkpoints.summary: Devbox-specific access, state, transport, identity, health, and security questions are answered before implementation begins.

checkpoints.title: Runtime contract ready
checkpoints.summary: The devbox research contract and the required upstream registry, sync, observation, and session-surface contracts are accepted without waiting on unrelated launch-from-graph work.

checkpoints.title: Devbox observability usable
checkpoints.summary: Registered devbox sessions are discovered, merged into the primary registry, and surfaced with trustworthy operational state.
